title_en: Fall 2026 Application for Credit Recognition of Military Service Remote Courses
summary: Students returning from military service in Fall 2026 who wish to have credit recognised for military remote courses taken during their service should apply on mySNU. Applications run from one week after the semester begins until the week before it ends, and applying between 7 September 2026 and 11 December 2026 is recommended. A military transcript or the completed form attached to the notice must be uploaded as supporting evidence.
applies_to: Students returning from military service in Fall 2026 (2026학년도 2학기 군 복학자) who wish to have credit recognised for military remote courses (군 원격수업) taken during their military service. Application is optional and only for those who wish credit recognition.

dates.what: Application period for credit recognition of military remote courses: from one week after the semester begins until the week before the semester ends; applying within the stated dates is recommended
dates.original_ko: 개강일로부터 일주일 후부터 종강일 전주까지 신청 (2026. 9. 7.(월) ~ 2026. 12. 11.(금) 신청 권장)

conditions: If you apply after your returning semester has passed, the system will show a message that you are not eligible to apply.
If you already have a transcript issued from the Narasarang Portal (나라사랑포털) or Jangbyeong e-Eum (장병e음), you must upload that transcript as evidence.
If you do not have a previously issued transcript, you must complete the form attached to the notice and upload it instead.
For grades from Spring 2026 onward, transcripts can be printed normally from the Jangbyeong e-Eum (장병e음) site, so you should use that transcript.
When completing the form, you must delete the example text shown in grey before filling it in.
The information on the form must be identical to the course and grade information shown under "Load from previously earned grades".
steps: Go to mySNU > Academic Information (학사정보) > Classes/Grades (수업/성적) > Grades (성적) > Credit Recognition Application (학점인정신청), and click "Apply" (신청) under [Military Leave Remote Courses] (군휴학 원격수업).
On the [Military Leave Remote Courses] (군휴학 원격수업) screen, click "Load from previously earned grades" (기취득성적에서불러오기).
From the courses displayed, select the courses for which you wish credit recognition.
Transcript already issued: Upload your Narasarang Portal (나라사랑포털) or Jangbyeong e-Eum (장병e음) transcript in the attachment field as evidence.
No transcript issued: Download the form attached to the original notice, (서식) 군복무 학점인정 신청서.hwp (Military Service Credit Recognition Application Form).

No transcript issued: Check the courses and grade information shown under "Load from previously earned grades" (기취득성적에서 불러오기), delete the grey example text in the form, and enter the same information in the form.
No transcript issued: Upload the completed form in the attachment field as evidence.
Click Save Temporarily (임시저장), then submit the application (신청).
translation:
Fall 2026 Application for Credit Recognition of Military Service Remote Courses

Students returning from military service in Fall 2026 who wish to have credit recognised for military remote courses taken during their military service should refer to the application period and method below.

<Application Period>
- Apply from one week after the first day of the semester until the week before the last day of the semester (applying between Monday 7 September 2026 and Friday 11 December 2026 is recommended).

<Application Method>
1. Application path: mySNU > Academic Information (학사정보) > Classes/Grades (수업/성적) > Grades (성적) > Credit Recognition Application (학점인정신청) – click "Apply" (신청) under [Military Leave Remote Courses] (군휴학 원격수업).

2. How to apply:
① On the [Military Leave Remote Courses] (군휴학 원격수업) screen, click "Load from previously earned grades" (기취득성적에서불러오기).
② From the courses displayed, select the courses for which you wish credit recognition.
③ In the attachment field, submit the material described in item 3 below as supporting evidence.
④ Save temporarily (임시저장) and apply (신청).

3. Supporting evidence to upload as an attachment
Case | Document to submit
If you have a previously issued document | Narasarang Portal (나라사랑포털) / Jangbyeong e-Eum (장병e음) transcript
If you do not have a previously issued document | Complete the 'form' attached to this notice and upload it
* From Spring 2026 grades onward, transcripts can be printed normally from the Jangbyeong e-Eum (장병e음) site, so please use that document.

4. How to complete the form: Look up "Load from previously earned grades" (기취득성적에서 불러오기) → check the courses for which you wish credit recognition and the related grade information → enter the same information in the [attached] form and upload it.
* Please note that if you apply after your returning semester has passed, a message will appear stating that you are not eligible to apply. Delete the example text shown in grey in the form before filling it in.

Attachment (1 file)
(서식) 군복무 학점인정 신청서.hwp (Military Service Credit Recognition Application Form, 60 KB) – the content of this attachment was not read.
